description: Build a lead list of websites that use specific software, e.g. every Shopify store using Klaviyo, or dental sites on WordPress, with each site's published phone numbers, emails and social profiles. Ask for as many as you need (default 25, up to 50); you pay only for sites returned. Filter by country and keyword. Use it to find prospects who already use (or need) what you sell. Price: $0.03 per company returned, charged only for what is returned; failed calls are free.

api_key.description: Your Unstuck API key, if this connection has none. Leave empty to try free tools or to get a key and payment link.

country.description: Two-letter country code to limit results, e.g. "US", "GB", "CA".

keyword.description: Optional word the site's title or description should mention, e.g. "coffee" or "dental".

limit.description: How many sites to return, default 25, max 50.

technologies.description: 1 to 3 technology names, spelled as the product is usually named, e.g. ["Shopify"], ["WooCommerce", "Klaviyo"], ["HubSpot"]. Sites must use all of them.

name: leads_by_tech

charged_usd.description: Amount charged for this call, USD.

country.description: Country code the site is associated with, e.g. US.

emails.description: Email addresses published on the site.

phone_numbers.description: Phone numbers published on the site.

social_links.description: Social media profile links found on the site.

technologies.description: Other technologies the site uses (up to 25).

total_matching.description: How many sites in the database match, before the limit.

title: Find Leads by Technology
